_about: Model registry for local_ai.ask model="auto" (tools/local_ai/ask.py). Adding a model = one entry here, with no code change. Lower tier is tried first; within a tier the starting model rotates so every model gets work. A "discover" entry asks an OpenAI-compatible gateway which models it serves (cached 5 min), so a model added to your gateway is used automatically. No secrets in this file: urls/keys come from the named env vars.

backends.name: local
backends.notes: Your own model server (llama.cpp, Ollama or LM Studio): LOCAL_AI_BASE_URL, ending in /v1, and the model's name in LOCAL_AI_MODEL; both are needed (`homeshed-mcp setup` finds them). Tried first; everything below is a fallback.

backends.name: gateway
backends.notes: An OpenAI-compatible gateway you run (for example LiteLLM) at LOCAL_AI_GATEWAY_URL, with LOCAL_AI_GATEWAY_KEY. Only its nvidia-* models are used, so a gateway alias for your local model never routes twice. Dormant until the URL is set.

backends.name: nvidia
backends.notes: NVIDIA's hosted models, for anyone without a GPU or a gateway. Dormant until NVIDIA_API_KEY is set (a free key from build.nvidia.com, for prototyping and personal use under NVIDIA's terms). Tier 4, so a local model or a gateway goes first.

backends.name: groq
backends.notes: Free tier (about 100 requests a minute). Dormant until GROQ_API_KEY is set; get a key at console.groq.com. Prompts leave your machine.

backends.name: openrouter
backends.notes: Free tier (free models only (ids end in :free): 20 a minute, 50 a day). Dormant until OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set; get a key at openrouter.ai. Prompts leave your machine.

backends.name: mistral
backends.notes: Free tier (about 1 request a second). Dormant until MISTRAL_API_KEY is set; get a key at console.mistral.ai. Prompts leave your machine.

backends.name: gemini
backends.notes: Free tier (about 15 a minute and 1,500 a day on the free Flash models). Dormant until GEMINI_API_KEY is set; get a key at aistudio.google.com. Prompts leave your machine.

backends.name: ovh
backends.notes: Free tier (2 a minute without a token; a free token raises it). Dormant until OVH_AI_ENDPOINTS_TOKEN is set; get a key at endpoints.ai.cloud.ovh.net. Prompts leave your machine.
